item: accent-color (Android): an app-wide accent colour setting. Presets Blue, Indigo, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Mint, Graphite, plus Custom, plus the default "Dynamic" (today's Material You). It drives the Material 3 colour scheme and the Liquid Glass accent, is persisted and backed up, and updates live. The player keeps its album-art colours, and the Player Theme option "System Dynamic" is renamed "Accent Color". Schemes use the vivid seed-chroma variant (owner option A, same algorithm as iOS).

1. Where the app colours come from today
- `ui/theme/Theme.kt:127-157` `PixelPlayTheme(darkTheme, colorSchemePairOverride = null)`. With no override and API 31+, it uses `dynamicDarkColorScheme(context)` / `dynamicLightColorScheme(context)`, remembered on (context, darkTheme, uiMode) (lines 136-148). An override wins next (150-153). On API 30 it falls back to the static `DarkColorScheme` / `LightColorScheme` (88-125; `LightPrimary` #6C4FF5 at `Color.kt:20`, which is also iOS's brand seed).
- Only two callers, and neither passes an override: `MainActivity.kt:331-333` and `ExternalPlayerActivity.kt:54`. So on the owner's Pixel 10 Pro (Android 16) the default is **dynamic Material You from the wallpaper**. "Default stays today's colours" therefore means Dynamic, not violet.
- The status and nav bars follow `finalColorScheme.background` (`Theme.kt:159-162`).

2. Player theme
- `ThemePreference` (`UserPreferencesRepository.kt:37-42`) has DEFAULT, DYNAMIC, ALBUM_ART and GLOBAL. The stored key is `player_theme_preference_v2`, default ALBUM_ART (`ThemePreferencesRepository.kt:18,28-30`).
- `ThemeStateHolder.kt:57-64` makes `activePlayerColorSchemePair` the album pair only for ALBUM_ART, otherwise null.
- The sheet resolves its scheme in `SheetThemeState.kt:46-58,71`: album scheme, else `systemColorScheme`, which is the root `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` passed at `UnifiedPlayerSheetV2.kt:582-590`.
- The scheme reaches the player through `ProvidePlayerScheme` (`PlayerSchemeScopes.kt:25-30`, `LocalMaterialTheme`).
- Settings › Appearance › Now Playing offers ALBUM_ART "Album Art" and DYNAMIC "System Dynamic" (`SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:695-705`; strings at `res/values/strings_settings.xml:189-192`, translated in 10 locales).
- So DYNAMIC already means "the player uses the app's scheme". Renaming it "Accent Color" keeps the behaviour: Material You while the accent is Dynamic, the chosen accent otherwise.

3. Glance widgets and Wear for DYNAMIC
- `MusicService.buildPlayerInfo` (`MusicService.kt:2089`; branch at 2161-2177) uses `dynamicLight/DarkColorScheme(applicationContext)`, cached in `cachedDynamicSchemePair` (2314) and cleared in `onConfigurationChanged` (1590-1595).
- `PhoneDirectWatchTransferCoordinator.resolveTransferThemePalette` (443-447) uses `dynamicDarkColorScheme(application)`.

4. Seed → scheme pipeline (`ui/theme/ColorRoles.kt`)
- `generateColorSchemeFromSeed` (151-181) builds `SchemeTonalSpot` / `Vibrant` / `Expressive` / `FruitSalad` (`createDynamicScheme` 548-559) from `com.google.android.material.color.utilities` (MDC `material = "1.14.0"`).
- Near-grey seeds are forced neutral via `shouldUseNeutralArtworkScheme` (616-619) and `toGrayscaleColorScheme` (632-691).
- `DynamicScheme.toComposeColorScheme()` (693-744) is private.
- `AlbumArtPaletteStyle` (`AlbumArtPaletteStyle.kt`) and `PaletteStyleSettingsScreen` only concern album-art schemes. `ColorSchemeProcessor` only produces album schemes (Room cache, `algo_v7`). Neither has an app-accent concept.

5. Liquid Glass
- `GlassPalette` (`ui/glass/theme/GlassPalette.kt`): every accent-coloured glass element (blobs, slider fill, toggle on, chip selection, light spill, settings icon discs `SettingsComponents.kt:1174`, choice values `:1285`) reads `palette.accent`. The tints themselves (`tint` / `tintStrong` / `tintSubtle`) are neutral black or white alphas.
- `GlassRoot` (`MainActivity.kt:1346-1378`) sets `accent = albumScheme?.primary ?: appScheme.primary` (line 1361), whatever the Player Theme. So in glass mode today the WHOLE app's glass accent follows the playing album. The player's glass controls read the same root palette (`GlassPlayerControls.kt:162-167`, `UnifiedPlayerSheetV2.kt:637-662`).
- Glass mode is resolved by `VisualStyle.isGlassMode` (`VisualStyle.kt:24-28`, pref `app_ui_style`, default LiquidGlass), read from the startup snapshot (`MainActivity.kt:735-741`).

6. Startup
- The splash stays up until `MainViewModel.startupPrefs` is non-null, at most 1 s (`MainActivity.kt:241-245`, `MainViewModel.kt:52-74`), so the first frame has the right theme.

7. Settings UI
- Appearance › Global Theme (`SettingsCategoryScreen.kt:640-691`): App Language, App Theme, Smooth corners, Disable blur, Show scrollbar.
- Row composables branch on `LocalGlassModeEnabled` (`SettingsComponents.kt:128-423`). The glass layout `GlassFlatSettingRow` (1139-1204) has a `below` slot but is `private`.
- Sheets use `AdaptiveModalBottomSheet` (`GlassAdaptive.kt:291-306`, which has `sheetGesturesEnabled`).
- `SettingsViewModel` exposes some prefs as separate StateFlows (`useSmoothCorners` 1430-1431).
- There is no accent setting and no colour picker anywhere (grep: no ColorPicker/HSV code, no picker library).

8. Persistence and backup
- `ThemePreferencesRepository` writes to the shared `settings` DataStore (`di/AppModule.kt:102-104`).
- `GlobalSettingsModuleHandler.export` (`GlobalSettingsModuleHandler.kt:22-31`) exports EVERY key via `UserPreferencesRepository.exportPreferencesForBackup` (1541-1559). Only `initial_setup_done` (126-128) and the playlist, quick-fill and EQ keys are excluded.
- `restore` clears and then `importPreferencesFromBackup` writes every entry by key and type (1561-1590).
- So any new string key is backed up and restored with no backup-code change. DataStore flows re-emit after a restore, which makes the restore update the app live.

9. Library APIs (javap on the Gradle cache)
- MDC 1.14.0 `DynamicScheme` has a public constructor `(Hct, Variant, boolean, double, TonalPalette×5)`, public final fields `secondaryPalette` / `tertiaryPalette` / `neutralPalette` / `neutralVariantPalette`, and `TonalPalette.fromHueAndChroma(double, double)`. All `@RestrictTo(LIBRARY_GROUP)`, like the `SchemeTonalSpot` the app already uses.
- material3 1.5.0-alpha22 has no public seed→scheme API (only `dynamicLight/DarkColorScheme(Context)` and `expressiveLightColorScheme()`).
- material3 `ColorScheme` does not override `equals`.
rootCause:
This is a missing feature, not a bug.
- The app scheme is hard-wired to Material You, with a static fallback (`Theme.kt:135-157`); there is no accent preference.
- In glass mode, the app-wide glass accent follows the playing album's primary (`MainActivity.kt:1361`), so a chosen accent would be overwritten on every track unless that line changes. The player sheet also needs its own album-accent palette, so the player keeps album colours.

risks: Cost of building the scheme. I timed it on the desktop JVM with the real MDC 1.14.0 classes: the first pair took 80-110 ms (including class loading), later pairs 6-15 ms each (16 ms interpreted). On the main thread that drops frames, so every call goes through `flowOn(Dispatchers.Default)` or `withContext(Default)`. A user who has chosen an accent can see the splash for up to that much longer at cold start (capped by `SPLASH_MAX_HOLD_MS` = 1 s, `MainActivity.kt:1331`). Measure on the Pixel; if needed, record it in `PerformanceMetrics`.

`DynamicScheme`, `TonalPalette` and `Variant` are `@RestrictTo(LIBRARY_GROUP)` in MDC 1.14.0 (checked in the class annotations), just like the `SchemeTonalSpot` the app already uses. Lint's RestrictedApi check may flag them, but lint is not enforced (`lint.checkReleaseBuilds = false`). A future MDC upgrade could change the constructor: newer material-color-utilities add SpecVersion/Platform parameters. The pinned-hex unit tests will catch that.

`androidx.compose.material3.ColorScheme` does not override `equals` (checked with javap). If pairs are not memoised by seed, every recomposition or flow emission gives a 'new' scheme and recomposes the whole app (the static `LocalColorScheme`). `AccentColorSchemes` and the `accentScheme` StateFlow must hand back the same instances.

Graphite needs the forced-neutral path. Without it, #8E8E93 (chroma 4.9) becomes BLUE #445E91 in light mode, because TonalSpot sets primary chroma to 36 (verified). With `shouldUseNeutralArtworkScheme` + `toGrayscaleColorScheme` it is #6A6A6A light / #D7D7D7 dark; light-mode contrast is primary/onPrimary 5.41, primary vs background 5.27, containers 6.61 (same as iOS). It is mid-grey, not black and white.

Glass-mode behaviour changes:
- With an accent chosen, the app-wide glass accent no longer follows the album. That is intended. The default Dynamic accent keeps today's album-following root accent exactly.
- The player wrapper means a user who had 'System Dynamic' (now 'Accent Color') in GLASS mode sees the player's glass accent change from album primary to the app primary. That matches the option's meaning and Material mode, but it is a visible change for them.
- The ambient background (artwork bake and blobs) stays album-driven.

The player glass override is provided around `UnifiedPlayerSheetV2` (`MainActivity.kt:1174`). Any player-related glass surface composed outside that subtree would show the app accent instead of album colours. Grep showed lyrics (`FullPlayerContent.kt:1062`), the queue and cast all live inside the sheet. Re-check if the glass-expansion or lyrics-page items move anything out.

Dark mode stays pastel. Dark primaries are tone 80, e.g. Red #FFB4AA and Blue #AAC7FF, identical to TonalSpot for most presets; Green #53E16F and Mint #39DCD2 are more vivid than TonalSpot. This matches how Material You looks on Android, but say it in the handoff.

Surfaces and secondary colours take the accent's hue. Neutral palettes have chroma 6/8 and secondary 16, so settings icons (`colorScheme.secondary`) and surfaces get a faint cast. That is normal Material dynamic colour; Material You already does it with the wallpaper hue.

Our accent schemes use MDC 1.14.0's MaterialDynamicColors. The default Dynamic scheme comes from material3's `dynamicLight/DarkColorScheme34` (system tokens on Android 14+). Surface-container tones can differ slightly between Dynamic and a preset.

Android 14+ has a system contrast setting (`UiModeManager.getContrast()`, API 34). Material You honours it; the accent schemes are built at contrastLevel 0.0 and do not. Optional follow-up: pass the contrast level into `DynamicScheme`.
Glance widgets and the Wear palette only rebuild on the next player update. Player Theme changes already behave the same way today.
